issues.claim: the window shows the last frame and can present it again without application code. After a few seconds Windows marks the window as "Not Responding"
issues.problem: The cited excerpts do not state this behaviour. On modern Windows, DWM keeps the window surface and substitutes a ghost window, so part of what the user sees is not WPF. The text says "can", which is acceptable for an open question.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a hedge such as "(partly thanks to DWM)" and keep "can" rather than "does".
